caption:
349,499 people rated this scale. 4.7 stars is the boring part.

Most bathroom scales get maybe a few hundred reviews before people quietly return them. This one has nearly 350,000 ratings sitting at 4.7 stars, which is a sample size most products never get close to. That volume is the argument, not a marketing line.

The Etekcity Digital Body Weight Bathroom Scale gives a simple digital readout with no setup beyond stepping on it. A rating this high held across 349,499 reviews means the complaints that usually sink a scale — inconsistent numbers, short battery life, a flimsy platform — aren't the pattern here.

For a home bathroom, that's a low-risk pickup: proven at scale, priced at $16.87.
